[[Baron/Legends|Baron]] '''Benton Kaldo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] businessman and [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Able to trace his his lineage to [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] nobility, Kaldo's wealth originated from his family's ancestral business success. He used that wealth to establish a syndicate that operated both legitimate enterprises as well as control over the majority of criminal activity on [[Centerpoint Station]], becoming a billionaire in the process. Kaldo enjoyed the benefits of his success, wearing only the finest clothing and the left the day-to-day operation of his business ventures to his [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]], [[Gustip]].
